data.content_ref: inline:Isolated 05b29af78bfb CONTRADICTS SRC_001 by asserting that a single evaluation's outcome-decorrelation requirement is incoherent: decorrelating checklist cues from the outcome on the same distribution destroys the validity of the checklist itself, so SRC_001's distinguishing criterion is not merely unavailable but self-defeating. The neighbourhood attempts to diagnose within-evaluation confounding, but 05b29af78bfb abstracts the problem one level higher to ask whether any within-evaluation decorrelation can preserve measurement validity at all. This relation is refuted if 05b29af78bfb's claim concerns something other than the logical coherence of within-evaluation decorrelation, or if SRC_001's criterion can be reformulated as distributional shift (cross-domain held-out items) rather than same-distribution decorrelation, making the two compatible rather than contradictory.
